$comment: Rule catalog — record. The record must be readable and identifiable before any standard can speak about it.

rules.title: The record conforms to the prediction-record schema
rules.description: The record validates against schemas/prediction-record.schema.json, including the prediction-versus-abstention discriminated union.
rules.rationale: Every other rule reads fields from this record. A record that does not conform is not a weakly supported prediction, it is an unread document, and evaluating it field by field would report absences that are really parse failures.
rules.remediation: Run the evaluator's reported schema errors to ground and correct the record shape.

rules.title: The record identifies itself and what it predicts
rules.description: The record carries an id, and a subject naming the event, the precise outcome definition, and the source that resolves it.
rules.rationale: A probability is a probability of something. Without a resolvable outcome definition the number cannot be scored, cannot be disagreed with, and cannot be calibrated against anything later.
rules.remediation: Add the missing subject fields. Write outcomeDefinition so that two people reading it after the event would agree on whether it happened.
